article.title: Punishment for attempt.
article.content:
15Punishment for attempt.

Section 15  ·  Chapter III  ·  page 11 of the Act
Whoever attempts to commit an offence referred to in 5[clause (a)] of sub-section (1) of section 13 shall be punishable with imprisonment for a term 6[which shall not be less than two years but which may extend to five years] and with fine.
5 Subs. by Act 16 of 2018, s. 9, for “clause (c) or clause (d)” (w.e.f. 26-7-2018).
6 Subs. by Act 1 of 2014, s. 58 and Sch. for “which may extend to three years” (w.e.f. 16-1-2014).
